_comment: Copy to mapping.json and edit. Windows paths need doubled backslashes.
nasRoots: every tree that might ALREADY hold this content. Listing the old
code-named tree as well as the current one is what stops a third copy.
driveRoots: Google Drive for Desktop mounts. Metadata is read; contents are
never read, so Stream mode stays streamed and nothing is downloaded.
aliases: folder names that mean the same project under different naming
conventions. A code like u0004 or ird0001 is also matched automatically.
map: longest matching drive prefix wins. The _fromDrive leaf keeps incoming
material beside the curated content rather than merged into it, so a bad
mapping is one folder to delete instead of an unpickable mess.

map.drive: Shared drives/UIH - UIZ - PMD Backup Documents and Data
map.note: example - replace with the real shared drive names
